w10_P4_000547: A dockside conveyor drives crates of mass 148 kg along a belt 40 m long. Each crate's acceleration in m/s^2 is 6 times the largest whole number that divides both 323 and 243 exactly. The drive on each crate is the force producing that acceleration plus 5 N of belt friction, minus 19 N supplied by a helper spring. Five identical crates are driven at once. What total drive force, in N, is supplied to the 5 crates?
w10_P4_000550: The figure a port engineer wants, in kN, is the total load on a gantry: 13 kN of static rigging plus the combined drive force of 5 identical cranes, each crane's drive force expressed in kN. Each crane drives 11 identical trolleys, and each trolley has a mass of 163 kg and a wheelbase of 1.8 m. The trolleys' acceleration in m/s^2 is the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 8x + 12 = 0, and each trolley is driven with the force producing that acceleration. What total gantry load, in kN, does the engineer report?
w10_P4_000552: The figure a workshop wants, in kJ (negative meaning a net loss), is the daily energy balance: the combined energy of motion of 12 identical batches, expressed in kJ, minus 7 kJ consumed by the workshop's compressor. Each batch is 6 identical carts, every cart carrying the same energy of motion. Each cart has a mass of 24000 grams. The carts' speed in m/s is the largest whole number that divides both 250 and 294 exactly. What daily energy balance, in kJ, does the workshop record?
w10_P4_000553: The number a depot wants, in kN, is the combined pusher load for 5 identical carts. Each cart's pusher load is the force producing its acceleration, minus 27 N supplied by a ramp, plus 22 N of wheel friction. Each cart has a mass of 162000 grams. The carts' acceleration in m/s^2 is the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 4x + 3 = 0. What combined pusher load, in kN, does the depot record?
w10_P4_000554: A lab bench drives a slider of mass 31 kg along a rail 1.6 m long. The slider's acceleration in m/s^2 is 2 times the largest whole number that divides both 21 and 199 exactly. The force producing that acceleration is supplied partly by a spring, which contributes 18 N, and the motor supplies the rest. Seven identical sliders run on identical rails, and a counterweight relieves 6 N of the 7 motors' combined output. What net output, in N, do the motors supply?
w10_P4_000559: The number a shipyard wants, in N, is the total load on a launch frame: 12 N from a guide spring plus the combined thrust of 5 identical bays, each bay driving 5 identical sleds, every sled receiving the same thrust. Each sled has a mass of 179000 grams. The sleds' acceleration in m/s^2 is 10 times the largest whole number that divides both 74 and 92 exactly, and each thrust is the force producing that acceleration. What total frame load, in N, does the shipyard report?
w10_P4_000560: A rocket sled of mass 174000 grams is accelerated along a rail at an acceleration in m/s^2 equal to 3 times the sum of 7 and 17. The force producing that acceleration is expressed in kN; the rail brake applies 15 kN in the opposite direction, and the difference, taking the drive direction as positive, is the net force per sled. Four identical sleds run at once, and a headwind adds a further 6 kN against the direction of travel to the combined net force of the 4 sleds. What is the resulting combined net force, in kN?
w10_P4_000563: The figure a ropeway operator wants, in kN, is the combined drive force of 2 identical lines, each line driving 10 identical gondolas, each gondola's drive force expressed in kN. Each gondola has a mass of 78 kg and runs on a level guide, and its velocity in m/s after t seconds is v(t) = 3t^3 - 6t^2. The drive force is the force producing the gondola's acceleration at t = 3 s. What combined drive force, in kN, does the operator report?
w10_P4_000569: The figure a launch crew wants, in N, is the total load on a sled's tow fitting: the drive force, minus 27 N supplied by a booster spring, plus 4 N of rail friction, plus 9 N of cable drag, plus 15 N from an instrumentation tether. The sled has a mass of 163000 grams. Its acceleration in m/s^2 equals the area under the curve y = 3x^2 + 7x between x = 0 and x = 3, and the drive force is the force producing that acceleration. What total fitting load, in N, does the crew record?
w10_P4_000573: A test sled of mass 59000 grams runs on a track 120 m long at a speed in m/s equal to 5 times the sum of 9 and 2. The logger takes the sled's energy of motion, subtracts 18 J lost to rail friction, adds 13 J from the brake spring, and subtracts 9 J vented as heat. Express the final logged energy in kJ.
w10_P4_000581: A bakery conveyor accelerates trays of mass 31 kg along a belt 9 m long. Each tray's acceleration in m/s^2 is the larger of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 12x + 35 = 0, and each tray is driven with the force producing that acceleration. A lane carries 2 identical trays, and the conveyor runs 4 identical lanes. Express the total drive force in kN.
w10_P4_000584: A bottling plant moves crates of mass 24000 grams at a speed in m/s equal to the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 9x + 8 = 0. A pallet holds 11 identical crates, a bay holds 2 identical pallets, and the plant has 12 identical bays. Express the total energy of motion of all the crates in kJ.
w10_P4_000590: The figure a marina wants, in kN, is the net winch load: the combined motor force of 7 identical winches, expressed in kN, minus 3 kN of relief from a counterweight. Each winch drags a boat cradle of mass 90 kg along a level slipway; the force producing the cradle's acceleration is supplied partly by a helper spring, which contributes 18 N, and the winch motor supplies the rest. The cradles' acceleration in m/s^2 equals the area under the curve y = 3x^2 + 4x between x = 2 and x = 3. What net winch load, in kN, does the marina report?
w10_P4_000592: A rescue drone of mass 55000 grams cruises at a speed in m/s equal to 3 times the sum of 2 and 15. Its energy of motion is expressed in kJ, and 2 kJ of reserve battery energy is added to give one drone's energy figure. A patrol is 9 identical drones. What is the patrol's total energy figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_000599: The figure a test-range officer wants, in kJ, is the combined net energy of 10 identical shots, expressed in kJ. Each shot's net energy is the projectile's energy of motion minus 27 J lost to barrel friction. Each projectile has a mass of 44 kg and a length of 0.6 m. The projectiles' speed in m/s equals the area under the curve y = 4x^2 + 0x between x = 3 and x = 4. What combined net energy, in kJ, does the officer record?
w10_P4_000600: The number a plant manager wants, in N, is the combined motor output for 12 identical carts. Each cart's motor output is the force producing its acceleration minus 24 N supplied by a helper spring. Each cart has a mass of 37000 grams and a bed 1.1 m long. The carts' acceleration in m/s^2 is 1 less than the area under the curve y = 2x^2 + 6x between x = 1 and x = 3. What combined motor output, in N, does the manager record?
w10_P4_000603: A sorting centre accelerates totes of mass 75000 grams along chutes 7 m long. Each tote's acceleration in m/s^2 is 3 times the sum of 2 and 11, and each tote is driven with the force producing that acceleration. A chute drives 12 identical totes, and the combined force per chute is expressed in kN. A hall has 3 identical chutes, and the centre has 10 identical halls. What total force, in kN, is applied to all the totes?
w10_P4_000605: The figure a lab wants, in kN, is the net drive on a bench: the combined push on 4 identical carts minus 29 N supplied by a helper spring. Each cart has a mass of 23 kg, and the push on each is the force producing its acceleration. The carts' acceleration in m/s^2 is the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 6x + 5 = 0. What net drive, in kN, does the lab record?
w10_P4_000609: A luggage cart of mass 107 kg is accelerated along an apron 55 m wide. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is found by taking the area under the curve y = 2x^2 + 0x between x = 0 and x = 3, subtracting 15, and multiplying by 8. The force producing that acceleration is supplied partly by a tailwind, which contributes 9 N, and the tug supplies the rest. What force, in N, does the tug supply?
w10_P4_000610: The figure a drone-range manager wants, in kJ, is the weekly total: 7 identical days, each day's figure being the combined energy of motion of 11 identical drones, expressed in kJ, minus 17 kJ consumed by the launch catapult. Each drone has a mass of 11000 grams. The drones' speed in m/s equals the area under the curve y = 1x^2 + 6x between x = 3 and x = 4. What weekly total, in kJ, does the manager record?
w10_P4_000612: A 15000 gram sled runs along a rail 6 m long at a speed in m/s equal to the area under the curve y = 2x^2 + 0x between x = 2 and x = 4. A logger takes the sled's energy of motion, subtracts 10 J lost to rail friction, adds 13 J from the brake spring, and adds 6 J from a charging coil. What final energy, in J, does the logger record?
w10_P4_000621: The figure a lab wants, in kJ, is the bench total: an intermediate figure plus 21 kJ from a storage battery. The intermediate figure, in kJ, is the combined energy of motion of 12 identical trolleys minus 2 kJ consumed by the drive motor. Each trolley has a mass of 23 kg. The trolleys' speed in m/s equals the speed at t = 1 s of a pace cart whose position in metres is s(t) = 3t^3 - 3t^2 with t in seconds. What bench total, in kJ, does the lab record?
w10_P4_000622: A cart of mass 79000 grams is driven along a level rail 20 m long. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is 11 more than the largest whole number that divides both 221 and 342 exactly. The force producing that acceleration is supplied partly by a helper spring, which contributes 12 N, and the motor supplies the rest. Seven identical carts are driven in the same way. What total force, in N, do the 7 motors supply?
w10_P4_000625: A pace car's position along a straight, in metres, is s(t) = 3t^3 - 4t^2 with t in seconds. A test sled of mass 153000 grams is given an acceleration in m/s^2 equal to 9 times the pace car's speed at t = 1 s, and the force producing that acceleration is expressed in kN. A rack of 9 identical sleds is driven at once, and a counterweight relieves 3 kN of the rack's combined force. What net force, in kN, does the rack's drive supply?
w10_P4_000631: A rescue drone of mass 40000 grams cruises at a speed in m/s equal to the area under the curve y = 1x^2 + 4x between x = 0 and x = 4. A patrol of 8 identical drones has a combined energy of motion, which the base expresses in kJ. The base subtracts 26 kJ consumed by the launch winch and then a further 22 kJ consumed by the ground station. What net figure, in kJ, does the base record?
